correctness.rationale: A one-error Z-channel downward ball of x consists of x and words obtained by erasing one 1-bit. Two balls are disjoint if and only if asymmetric distance max(#1->0,#0->1)>=2. Reconstructed both adjacency definitions for all 32 words; independently enumerated ALL maximal cliques with a separate graph implementation and obtained maximum size 6 and exactly 120 maximum six-word codes. The S5 coordinate group plus global bit-complement acts by graph automorphisms (even though complement exchanges up/down, the symmetric max distance is invariant); exhaustive orbit calculation yields precisely three orbits of sizes 30,30,60, stabilizers 8,8,4 by 240/orbit size. Thus no unenumerated larger or six-word codes; this is finite exact graph exhaustion, not a bound from sampled constructions.

Resultary publishes the structurally related LENGTH-SIX Z-channel optimum (size12, 30 maxima), fully inspected and distinguished by underlying length; neither its result nor classical known cardinality implies this length-five 120-code orbit classification.
